identity.question: US-Iran Final Nuclear Deal by December 31, 2026?

rule_pointer: Run scripts/deep_review_resume.py --index 455 for full frozen rule; criteria hash above.
scope: Facts only; no market judgment, probability, eligibility, ranking, or account data.
facts: The official White House page dated 2026-06-19 states that President Trump and Vice President Vance signed an MOU with Iran. The page includes a quoted statement describing a 60-day MOU effort and future negotiations toward a final agreement; that quoted language is attributed to a third party on the White House page, not itself the MOU text.

Both requested Iran Watch public pages (Foreign Ministry statement and MOU text) returned HTTP 403; their content was not parsed. No signed text or official Iranian statement was independently verified in this capture. The frozen case requires mutual signing/adoption by both governments and at least one concrete, measurable nuclear-program limitation expressed as an unconditional present obligation; these captures do not establish those elements.
